metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Outer Hip Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to instantly relieve outer hip pain.

If you're dealing with pain, aches, and tightness around the outer hip, definitely check this video out.

This is usually caused by a combination of muscle weakness and tightness that builds up over time in the main muscles that support this area. This includes the gluteal muscles (glutes).

To fix this, we'll go over easy exercises to help stretch and strengthen these muscles for both quick and long-lasting relief. To get the best results, go through them all and use the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and learn how to instantly fix outer hip pain at home!

0:00 Intro
